notes.title: August Production Report
notes.content:
Hello there! 

As promised, here’s some fresh news about ARISEN:
[list][*] As we talked before we are still scouting for partners to port the game on Switch & mobile. [i]Get in touch if you are interested![/i][/list][list]
[*] Meanwhile, we are planning to work on a new patch to improve the game. It should contain: 
[list]
[*] [b]Gamepad compatibility[/b] is on its way: you’ll be able to play from your favorite spot in no time with the Steam Deck. We are assessing if it’s possible to make the game playable onto it[/list][list]
[*] Maybe some [b]new content for ACT3[/b], but just a small teasing.[/list][/list][list]
[*] On a less optimistic note: in order to ensure transparency, we have to share that the 3rd act is still on hold, as we are unfortunately not generating enough revenue to support further development.
[i]Have a peek:[/i] [/list][list][list]
[*] Since we brought the game 1 year ago, we roughly sold more than 1500 units of the games, just enough to refund the invest for the game rights 
[*] But not enough to invest and pay for the third act.[/list][/list]
Rest assured that we still have the best at heart for Arisen. So be sure to share your interest and talk about it in your friends circle, it would help a lot! 
We also believe that releasing the game out of Early Access before the end of the year and porting it  on mobile and / or Switch will add more revenue and give a boost to sell more copies. 

[list][*] On a brighter side: we are participating in the [b]Visual Novel Fest[/b] on Steam from the 7th to the 14th of August, where you can grab our game for the first time at a huge discount : [b]-50%[/b]![/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/0279e468e3d03d7f3cef8ff1d08b22067552772e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1101670/ARISEN__Chronicles_of_VarNagal/

The next months will be dedicated to the release of ARISEN in its final version. We hope with all our hearts that it will generate enough revenue to sustain the ACT3. [b]Keep your fingers crossed, and stay tuned![/b]

notes.title: ARISEN new game update, OST release and ARISEN purchase
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/13dbe5e1b5a0a358f553cd281df1d265971817d5.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Here’s Ben from Homecoming Studio: You may remember me as I worked with Maratus on the marketing and producing side, from the Kickstarter to the end. 
Today I’m writing on the Homecoming Studio behalf:  We’re happy to share that we have bought back ARISEN since the bankruptcy of Maratus! 
A good way to keep the game in the hands of people that worked on the production. :) 

I’m sure your next question is:[b] What will be the future for ARISEN? [/b]

So far here’s our roadmap: 

[h3]This week: [/h3]
- We will release a new game update! It will contains a few bugfixes that improve stability and the overall game visual experience. It’s the last patch made by the Maratus team. You will find the patch note after. 

- We’re ready to publish the Original Soundtrack composed by Yann Rayon, we will send it to the Kickstarter Backers this week. By the end of the month, the soundractk will be available on other musical streaming platforms. We are also thinking about publishing it on Steam too and we would like to hear from you: do you want it here too? 

- We will also take down the Prologue Version. The purpose was initially to support the Kickstarter campaigns and get a maximum of feedback from our community (you!). But as we have now the demo on our main Steam Page, we want to avoid spreading the traffic, or maintain the content there. 
You will continue to have access to the prologue for free by downloading the demo version on the main page.

[h3]In the next month:[/h3]
Our wish is to releae one way or another the end of ARISEN in the future. That's why our current plan is to retain as much money we can from the sales. At the moment, it is insufficient to cover the development cost for the Act3. Which means the development of Act 3 is officially on hold. 

We are looking for partners or deals to continue the development further and maybe release the game on other platforms than Steam. I'll keep you posted on what happens next! 

We still definitely need your support. So please, do not hesitate to share the game around you and recommend it to your friends, family, colleagues or your favourite streamers!
Also, do not hesitate to leave a positive review on Steam or to wishlist it if you don't already own the game. It will boost our visibility on the store!

Wish you the best, thank you for your support!
Ben.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/6a56a0864b8a2b3ecf9184886baf1ea5036188cd.png[/img]

Hello everyone! ❤️

Here comes a new patch full of little improvements that we hope you'll like! 
There is a few new features like the weather system or the rework of the save system.
We expect way less problems with saves now! 
Also! From now if you reach the second act, you'll be able to restart from that point for your current save, keeping all you choices made in the first act! 
(you may try it with an existing save, but it might not take every previous choices into account so we recommend you use that with new saves)

You'll find the complete list just bellow!

Have a nice weekend travelers ❤️
The Maratus team

[*] Weather system on backgrounds
[*]🃏 Added the possibility to restart a save at the start of Act2

[b]Quality of life:[/b]

[*] Changed the Character creation menu to make it simpler

[*] Improved how the quick load work
[*] Player Skin in loadgame and journal should change according to player status ingame
[*] Added more ambient sounds on backgrounds

[/list]

[list]
[*] Buttons not used in menus are now deleted
[*] Changed a card in Koda A1Q1C4 from Sorrow-Silence to Joy-Pleasure

[*] Corrected some Quick load bugs
[*] [Loca:EN] Fixed a database bug that prevented secondary character names to be localized
[*] Fixed a bug on notes/logs that prevented them to appear in some situations
[*] Fixed an error on cards in journal that could caused the game to lag or freeze
[*] Added Nesharif missing sprites
[*] Corrected more typos
[/list]

[b]Known bugs we are working on:[/b]
[list]
[*] Residual typos (mainly on the paths that are less playtested)
[*] Remaining localization and tag problem in texts
[*] Adding popups or warning when a choice will lead to a big change
[/list]

[b]Features we are working on:[/b]

[*] Game optimization for lower configs
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/2425ef29706f3e377f5150ae0b49907b3d1f6f2c.png[/img]

Hello everyone! ❤️

Today is a big day! We can announce that ARISEN’s Act 2 is fully playable!

It’s a whole new part of the story to read! Hope you will like it, let us know!

You will meet again with Igweneil, Rahis, Waard, Viziriad… The Love and Hate cards will be available. Who would you like to kiss? Shall you have a rival? 

What are the Mehve’s plans for the future? Where is Tarak? Will you make good choices to meet the pirate queen Aridiel?

And that’s it for the main part of the update, but it also comes with fixes that you will find in the patch note here. 

We're always listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/3ca0e88e4c21fe2437da2a39173ce324860471d2.png[/img]

Hello everyone! ❤️

We are here with some good news!

We have just released a new patch for ARISEN. What kind of changes have we made?

[*] Multiple backgrounds bug who come on top of the previous ones should be fixed,
[*] The journal is finally back (yeah!), check the cards you unlocked in it, the log files and your character sheet with your current relationship with the mains characters,
[*] A time feature has been added: starting now the background will have a night and day cycle. 
You can now unlock the Act 1 epilogue after the quests of Igweneil and Baeli, instead of the quests of the 6 main characters, which simplify the replayability of the game.
Be careful: you won’t be able to complete these quests before starting the second Act of the game. 

And that’s it for the main part of the update, but it also comes with many fixes that you will find in the patch note here. 

And for the good news, we shall be back to you very soon to reveal the acte 2 release date!

We're still listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord. 

Have a nice week travelers ❤️
The Maratus team

notes.title: The Act 1 Epilogue is out! ✨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/b10291652ddf11a38e99869b6e6672288bc33170.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

[i]“Have you received your invitation? From Sujik to Prora’I’Ganda, all Maccials talk about the preparation of the big event. Get ready for the birthday celebration of the heir of the God-King. It is said that slaves who have shown great qualities are set free... “[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/6398fd715e47734dc0e920c4e58fea98e5c90e04.png[/img]

Here it’s our first update: the Act 1 Epilogue is now out!
With this first big update, you will be able to play the full First Act of the game, from the start to the end. 

Go back to your favorite playable character, take your courage in both hands, and go to the royal heir’s birthday party… It’s time to Meet the God King Mehve. 

Once you’ve finished the epilogue, you may be really curious to know when the prologue of the second Act shall be released! Don’t worry, we’re working on an updated roadmap to keep you informed on the next steps.

[b]What have we added or fixed recently?[/b]

[list]
[*]Starting from the tarot table, you will be able to launch the Epilogue by clicking on the Mehve’s pendant and unlock the end of the Act 1. Beware, there will be no turning back so be sure to complete everything you want before clicking!
[*]We have also set up achievements: you can now unlock 6 Steam successes in Act 1.
[*]From now on, saves will be shared between computers with the Steam Cloud Save system.
[*]We’ve fixed more than 25+ bugs, dead ends, relationships errors and more quality of life things, so if you want to know more please check our patch note on Steam!
[/list]

If you haven't already done so, don't hesitate to post reviews on Steam and send us your comments and opinions on the first act of the game! 

We can't thank you enough for your support! ❤️

We're still listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/36472f4e9d12f02ab19bb54704dd25a760358d5f.png[/img]

In this new hotfix, with more content than the previous one, our team was able to fix some bugs that the community reported to us. We are trying a new and improved save system, with an autosave that activates before each new card choice, with the coin animation feedback. The manual save is still in place, so it’s the best of both worlds!  Hope you will like it. ❤️

We're still listening to your feedback, please use the bug report tool with the F8 key in game or you can still reach us on our Discord.

[*] Fixed Koda A1Q3C4 conditions that changed relation were inverted
[*] Fixed wrong character speaking (Igweneil; not the narrator)

notes.title: It's time to play the new demo!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38226650/04440ec92eb3c57ecb2bfab51cc373eaab6cc56c.jpg[/img]

Here it’s, [b] our new demo is now available![/b] We’re very happy to allow you to play more of our game and get a glimpse of what’s ahead. 

📜 But before you play, some words about the demo: 

[list]
[*]Your progress in this demo won’t be kept for the full game (so maybe try something different that you want for your story)
[*]Your progress is automatically saved, so feel free to quit and come back later if needed
[*]The game is still in an early alpha state, so if you notice something weird, press F8 to send feedback, a bug or something else. Make sure to give us as much information as you can and if you can join us on Discord or on the Steam forum to discuss it!
[*]Please enjoy this new content!
[*]And if you want to stream this new demo, you can! Just let us know when, so we can come in the chat or share your live on our social media!
[/list]


📜Check out our new gameplay trailer:

[previewyoutube=99wmdqwiwuc;full][/previewyoutube]

And that’s it! We hope you will like this new demo!

Have a nice Steam Next Fest!
Maratus Team. 💖

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign + Prologue new patch change log
notes.content:
[b]Hello travellers![/b]

Today is an important day for the team: our Kickstarter campaign is live and you now have the possibility to help us!

[previewyoutube=UTK-Dd4aO7k;full][/previewyoutube]
But why Kickstarter and why do you need our support?

70% of our development budget is already funded.

Your support here on Kickstarter enables us to finance the full development of ARISEN! We want to have the chance to add the missing features and illustrations, to offer more and more story content, and of course to give ARISEN the best English translation.

We also want to work with our community to get as much feedback as early as possible to make our game the visual novel the gamers actually want. Don’t be shy! Tell us what you like in the alpha demo, share your opinion with us. We love interacting with players, whether it be on Discord or social media!

We can make the dark fantasy narrative game you are waiting for! 
You can support us here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maratus/arisen-a-narrative-card-game]Arisen Kickstarter[/url]

notes.title: Dev's News #2
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/5a8f0ba714b5dab518b278a19d09f145f68a8f47.png[/img]

Hello traveller,

Nice of you to pay me a visit. Have a seat. You came to me for news, didn’t you? You want to know more about ARISEN… What can I tell you?

[h1]GAMESCOM[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/15e9af12df86b4a2cb5b5966bdd61304470768c3.jpg[/img]

The fellowship of Maratus met a lot of people in Köln! Warriors, mages, bards, druids… It was an exhausting yet terrifying journey. The feedbacks about the demo were excellent. Elene, Sylvain and Anaïs were pleased to be introduced to new, interesting, crazy people in the taverns of Köln.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35279200/b9642490b06b89feb13883c170569fa9a743e2e6.jpg[/img]

Elene is on the left, Sylvain is on the middle, and Anaïs on the right. They seem harmless but they are mischevious creatures, so… Be prepared!

[h1]KODA’S FACIAL EXPRESSIONS[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/YO9zGr9rnblQPPZUeK/giphy.gif[/img]

Now Koda is able to show you his feelings. Joy, fear, disgust, anger… Will appear on his face. He can be rude sometimes… But if he trusts you, he will be the sweetest man ever, dear. 

[h1]ANOTHER VIEW OF THE GLOBAL MAP[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35279200/404ba6c695178e4488b2ab00cb07b2f82e36cd80.png[/img]

Here is the south east of Var’Nagal. In Woshuxi you’ll find nomadic clans of humans and orcs. They’re kept under surveillance by the winged halflings and suspicious gnomes living in the closed mountains...

Thank you for listening to an old crazy lady, traveller. We’ll meet again I promise: then I will tell you more about ARISEN, Var’Nagal and the fellowship of MARATUS...

Have a nice day,
[i]Sage Zorah[/i]

tags.feature: Now Koda is able to show you his feelings.
